title: Revenue-agents authorized to appear, etc., in rent-suits
text:
26. Revenue-agents authorized to appear, etc., in rent-suits.—Notwithstanding anything

contained in Act No. XX of 1865, all persons duly admitted and enrolled as Revenue-agents under that
Act in Oudh may appear, plead and act in suits under the Oudh Rent Act (19 of 1868) in the Courts
of officers exercising the powers of Assistant Collectors, Deputy Collectors, Collectors and
Commissioners under the same Act.
